title: The Months: Caesars and Counting
label: ch:months-caesars
canDo: I can name the last six months in French and explain why four of them are counting wrong.

payoff.summary: Two men put themselves in a calendar of gods, and the four months after them have been miscounting ever since. juillet is Julius Caesar and aout is the emperor Augustus; wedging those two into the middle is what pushed septembre to decembre two places out of place.
payoff.note: Authored as part of the chapter-9 split: length is never a cost, so sixteen months-and-seasons became three chapters rather than one dense one. The payoff is atom-scored -- it assesses every atom its chapter introduces.
